profile.headline: Software Engineer at AIS (Applied Information Sciences)
profile.summary: I am a software engineer, teacher, and open source contributor. I have professional experience developing software in government, education and insurance industries. I was recently accepted as a Pluralsight Author so be on the look out for my first course. Through my Pluralsight works, I intend to build up a vast and expansive library of web development training ranging from AWS, ReactJS, Elm, Elixir, and Machine Learning. I also aim to empower developers, new and experienced, to accomplish their goals by making complex subjects simple.

company.name: American Farmers & Ranchers Mutual Insurance Company

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description:
As a senior engineer I worked on Connections flagship education platform and reduced the number of data discrepancies that would often occur with third party vendor API's. By interfacing and working hand in hand with multiple vendors and refactoring many code modules I was able to ensure that students would have a smooth and enjoyable transition between their virtual courses, thus increasing student productivity.

RESPONSIBILITIES:

1.) Developed a student data importer that interfaced with third party vendor API’s.

2.) Interfaced with customers and vendors to gather requirements and help them with API creation.

3.) Discovered and fixed the underlying errors with the student data layer.

ACHIEVEMENTS:

1.) Deployed a student data importer that continuously imports data from third party vendors.

2.) Successfully created a more open line of communication between third party vendors and Connections Educations development teams.

3.) Corrected a long standing bug in the student data layer.

4.) Reduced the cyclomatic complexity of many methods within a clients legacy app which uncovered a huge grade calculation bug that I then fixed and pushed to production without a hitch.

ENVIRONMENT:

    ASP.NET MVC, C#, SQL Server

positions.title: Senior Software Developer
positions.description:
Before Advanced Academics was bought by Connections Education my team and I were working on an internal project to help our teachers and administrators be more productive by creating a better gradebook, chat & student administration site.

RESPONSIBILITIES:

1.) Developed a fully featured chat web application with video, and a blackboard for teachers to interact with students.

2.) Developed a new gradebook application to increase teacher productivity.

3.) Completely designed a more modern UI for the student administration application.

4.) Developed a dynamic student search for the company management system.

ACHIEVEMENTS:

1.) With the use of Microsoft's SQL Profiler, I was able to optimize some stored procedures and speed up student search times.

2.) Created a data layer to interact with CouchDB & SQL Server.

3.) Created a custom Angular.js directive to display new chat window views and filter bad language.

4.) Created custom Angular.js services to promote code reuse.

ENVIRONMENT:

    ASP.NET MVC, C#, Node.js, Angular.js, Socket.io, CouchDB & SQL Server

positions.title: Software Developer
positions.description:
As a member of Advanced Academics software development team, I helped maintain and add features to the company's flagship product, Roads; an learning management system. I also did Salesforce development and wrote C# scripts to migrate data into the new environment.

RESPONSIBILITIES:

1.) Worked heavily with end users to gather requirements for a major Salesforce data migration. 
     Once we had a solid plan, I developed an application to migrate legacy data to the new 
     Salesforce application.

2.) Sticking to MVC I helped my team modularize the existing code base and also implement TDD.

3.) Completely rewrote the company Salesforce java application and it’s data layer.

4.) Refactored legacy Salesforce stored procedures and triggers.

5.) Developed multiple websites for virtual schools partners across the state of Oklahoma.

ACHIEVEMENTS:

1.) The Salesforce data migration application I wrote ran successfully at launch with no errors and 
     took only 1 hour to import tens of thousands of student, teacher and administration records.

2.) After my team completely revamped the Salesforce application we were able to achieve and 
     maintain a 95% code test rating for the entire code base.

3.) Implemented the MVC pattern for the Salesforce apex pages.

ENVIRONMENT:

    ASP.NET MVC, C#, Java, SQL Server and various JavaScript libraries.

positions.title: Web Services Developer
positions.description:
I worked on the migration of sales tax for the state of Oklahoma. I developed two different applications for Sales and Use Tax and did maintenance on a legacy application that had an Oracle database for our internal Integrated Tax System (ITS). The web services that I created for the migration were tied to the ITS and any taxpayer that registered through the external web application were registered directly on the ITS and was successfully migrated from the legacy database. 

RESPONSIBILITIES:

1.) Worked with vendors to transmit proper sales and use tax account data.

2.) Created a web service to accept Exactor sales and use tax transaction data for non streamlined sales tax merchants.

3.) Developed a service to migrate sales tax data from the Integrated Tax System to the new GenTax application.

4.) Maintained legacy mainframe code. 

ACHIEVEMENTS:

1.) Created a secure solution to successfully transmit consumer sales tax and use tax.

2.) I took on a huge consumer tax migration project and meet all deadlines.

3.) Created a proper version control process for the IT department.

ENVIRONMENT:

ASP.NET, C#, C++, Java, Oracle, Python And COBOL
